hints.tr: Yükleme adımına `if: always()`; yoksa düşen testten sonra atlanır.
hints.en: `if: always()` on the upload step; otherwise it is skipped after a failing test.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest --junitxml=report.xml
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-report
          path: report.xml
          retention-days: 14
```
